g.text: FAN INTERFACE - FAN DOMAIN (GND_F). Fail-off, isolated (SR-08, SR-09, D-023, D-054; interfaces §2.1). >= 3 mm to node copper (pcb/SAFETY.md)

g.text: INDICATOR: 6 x SK6812SIDE-A on the carrier's room-side edge (D-055, FR-15). GPIO21 -> 2N7002 inverter (RMT invert_out). 10k gate pull-up keeps DIN low (idle) through reset. Firmware caps LED current at 300 mA

g.text: SEN65 (D-012) on +3V3. Shares the Waveshare I2C bus; its pull-ups are on that board, so ours are DNP pads (D-054)

g.desc: SEN65 (D-012) on +3V3. Shares the Waveshare I2C bus; its pull-ups are on that board, so ours are DNP pads (D-054)

g.text: J-DC: wired DC_RUNNING, 12-24 V AC/DC either polarity (IR-01, D-025) - DC field domain

g.desc: J-DC: wired DC_RUNNING, 12-24 V AC/DC either polarity (IR-01, D-025) - DC field domain

g.text: PWRON ONE-SHOT (DNP, D-056): holds AXP2101 PWRON low ~2-6 s after VBUS rises, in case the PMU's eFuse doesn't power on at VBUS insertion. Fit only if the bench needs it (interfaces §3)
